articleTitle: Railway Track Diagnostics by Combined Kinematic and Vibroacoustic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper analyzes the use of small-sized inertial measuring systems, the sensors of which are installed in the immediate vicinity of the wheel/rail contact zone. This allows to combine the means of controlling oscillatory (mechanical) and vibrational (acoustic) effects caused by the passage of defective track elements into one device. The mechanical and acoustic properties of the car/rail track system are analyzed. The methods of kinematic analysis and vibroacoustics, which are applicable for monitoring the state of structural elements of the car and rail track, are considered.

articleTitle: Determining the Type of Interference in a Receiving Antenna Using Machine Learning in Fog Computing Environments
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article describes a small view of the interference type in the receiving antenna. The new opportunities of computing vision for the conception of oscillograms for a specialist in digital signal processing are described. A new approach is proposed for the interaction of a specialist in digital signal processing and interference with pattern recognition using a smartphone. According to three standards, at the design stage, a description of the architecture of the proposed system is given. An approach for a smartphone has been created and viewed. Efficiency of using fog and cloud computing to determine types of interference using pattern recognition has been proven, and specific examples are provided.

articleTitle: Study of the Characteristics of EEG Frequency Patterns: the Automatic Marking of Sleep Stage without Additional Physiological Signals
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Within the framework of this work, we studied frequency patterns calculated on the basis of the concept of continuous wavelet transformation in the electrical activity of the brain of the subjects during night sleep. A comparison of the detected frequency patterns in different frequency ranges with different sleep stages in the subjects was carried out. At the same time, the question of the possibility of using the concept of frequency patterns for the implementation of automatic marking of polysomnographic records at the sleep stage without the participation of a somnologist was considered.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Techniques within a Technological Process of Manufacturing Automated Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The solution of quality control problems in production is in many ways like the optimization of automated control systems of technological processes. These issues are decided using mathematical methods of operations exploration, numerical minimization methods and others.One of the new and effective methods of analyzing the state of the production system in industry 4.0 is neural network data analysis. The ongoing research on the use of neural networks is aimed at their use in solving production management problems.It is proposed to use artificial intelligence apparatus to optimize separate multi-nomenclature production. Each new task of optimal choice of parameters for the structure of production should be based on previously revealed decisions. Thus, it is proposed to create a learning system that provides a solution based on the accumulated "knowledge". Neural networks appertain to such systems [7]–[12].Neural networks will solve 2 tasks:• will be an "add-on" over the existing Product Lifecycle Management and Enterprise Resource Planning functionality at enterprises;• will take into account factors affecting production.The proposed approach should expand the enterprise's mobility capabilities in making managerial decisions at all levels of management, throughout the life cycle. The models being developed should become a functional extension of digital production processes.

articleTitle: The Usage of a Simple SchoolMIPS Soft-Processor Core for Teaching Students the Computer Microarchitecture
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This paper considers the usage of a schoolMIPS soft-processor core as an infrastructure for teaching students the computer microarchitecture and hardware description languages. The paper considers in detail the microarchitecture and several implementations of the core, as well as the possibility of using it in large-scale projects, such as multiprocessor systems, and implementation schoolMIPS in a university by the example of MIEM HSE. A comparison of schoolMIPS with such cores as MIPS, MIPSfpga, and RISC-V is given.

articleTitle: Methods and Technologies for Designing Digital Information Models of Oil Recycling Processes
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The methodology of designing digital information models of oil recycling processes is presented, which includes three main design stages: selection and layout of technological equipment, piping and formation of a complete digital model, which is the basis for the formation of digital production twins. A computer system is described, including a complex of computer-aided design tools: databases of equipment, raw materials, catalysts, pipeline elements, a library of mathematical models, the system allows solving the problem of creating digital information models for this class of objects. The system was tested using the example of the catalytic cracking process and confirmed its operability.

articleTitle: Relevance of Mathematical Modeling Methods for High-Tech and High-Precision Products Quality Assurance Control
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article attempts to analyze the existing innovative methods of mathematical modeling in relation to product quality management and digital twins of the enterprise. The main purpose of this article is to assess the relevance and role of mathematical modeling methods for product quality management in relation to the production of high-tech and precision products.

articleTitle: Knowledge Management Subsystem of the Intellectual Situational Center
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Within the framework of the situational center, a knowledge management subsystem is identified and considered, which solves the following tasks: identification and accounting for the uncertainty of the initial information, automated selection of mathematical methods for describing systems, assessment and modeling of the situation, taking into account information about the structure of the control object and its functioning at a particular point in time, provides interaction with experts and extracts knowledge from the Internet. The solution of these problems is achieved using separate interconnected modules, which makes it possible to use the situational center in various subject areas, manage complex hierarchical systems, and also make an automated choice of mathematical methods for processing information.

articleTitle: Digitalization of the Company's Business Processes Based on Technological Innovations
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: One of the types of business process automation technologies is the Robotic Process Automation (RPA) technology. The introduction of technological innovations is a capital–intensive and high-risk process, therefore it requires a thorough feasibility study, each company must independently assess the scale of automation, its feasibility and consequences. The problem is the substantiation of the approach to assessing the feasibility of introducing RPA technology to automate the business processes of an infocommunication company. In the course of the study, the characteristics of typical business processes of infocommunication companies were analyzed and a system of criteria was determined for selecting business processes that should be automated using RPA technology. The result is a system of criteria for selecting business processes of an infocommunication company to be automated.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence as a New Stage in the Development of Business Intelligence Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The integration of BI systems with machine learning tools and the expansion of the capabilities of business intelligence systems due to this are priority areas of work for most developers of BI solutions. 2020-2021 became significant in the development of BI systems, when the leaders in the BI analytics market started massively present their solutions based on the interaction of artificial intelligence and business intelligence, which made advanced real-time data analytics possible. Manufacturers of BI systems strive to take into account the different needs of users, that is why they develop different approaches to integrate machine learning into Business Intelligence systems. The purpose of this work is to reveal the advanced possibilities of using artificial intelligence (AI) in Business Intelligence systems, depending on the approach to integrating AI algorithms into a BI system.

articleTitle: Digital Technologies in Quality Management
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Quality management in the context of digitalization requires the development of new approaches. The paper analyzes the possibilities of creating a digital quality management system and shows the main directions of development. Digital technologies in quality management will allow the company to carry out centralized control at all stages of the life cycle, including design, modeling, production, quality control of products and processes.

articleTitle: Risk Management Process in the Digital Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Currently, many organizations are moving to new digital management systems, which is accompanied not only by the introduction of new approaches based on the use of information technology, but also by a change in the organizational and management environment. Risk management is a process necessary to maintain the competitive advantage of an organization, but it can also become involved in the course of digitalization itself, which means that risk management also needs to change to meet modern conditions and ensure the effectiveness of the organization. This article discusses the risk management process in the digital environment. The main approach to the organization of this process is outlined, taking into account the use of information tools, together with the stages of this process, which directly affect the efficiency of the company. The risks that are specific to a digital organization are taken into account. Modern requirements for risk management for organizations are studied, ways of their implementation are outlined. The result is a risk management process that functions in a digital organization.

articleTitle: Intelligent Collision Danger Assessment of Autonomous Unmanned Sea-Going Vessels
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Navigation safety of both sea-going crewed ships and sea-going autonomous unmanned ships is possible to improve by enhancing navigation engineering facilities, including software and soft hardware (firmware), providing control over navigation tools on such ships. The article dwells on the technique of an intelligent assessment of collision danger for autonomous unmanned vessels with the surface crafts facing them along their seaway. The intelligent assessment is carried out by synthesizing three values given by three modules which are different in input data. The first module uses the information on bearing and distance, the second one is based on computing distance and time of approach of ships, and the third renders the information on bearing, speed and a target ship heading got from the radar system. Each module actively processes the information got from sensors for transferring it to the intelligent unit, which decides on the necessity of maneuvering of collision avoidance to the dangerous objects found on a seaway of an autonomous unmanned vessel. Each module uses a model explored in fuzzy and neuro-fuzzy bases. Upon that, quality assessment calculations show it is the neuro-fuzzy approach that allows for a uniquely determined danger level.

articleTitle: Development, Implementation and Certification of a New Generation of Quality Management Systems for Organizations of the Aviation and Space Industries
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article discusses the main stages of the development and implementation of quality management systems (QMS) of a new generation for enterprises of the aviation and space industries. Special attention is paid to the consideration of key problem areas and "bottlenecks" that organizations face when implementing industry-specific QMS. A set of measures is proposed to mitigate unacceptable risks of the project of implementing an industry-specific QMS. An algorithm for the transition of the management system to new versions of international and national standards of the 9100 series is proposed. The problems are considered and mechanisms for building an independent conformity assessment (certification) are proposed QMS in the context of changing external geopolitical factors.

articleTitle: Novel RNS Reverse Conversion Algorithm Based on Core Function
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Residue Number System (RNS) provides advantages for accelerating arithmetic computations using multiplications and additions only due to absence of long carry propagation logic in its modular adders and multipliers. However, a conversion from RNS to Binary Number System (BNS) is a well-known complex operation requiring larger hardware area and consuming more power than modular multipliers which significantly limits applicability of RNS. Many non-modular operation (e.g. comparison, division) implementations are also based on reverse conversion. This article presents a novel algorithm for RNS to BNS reverse conversion for an arbitrary modular set based on a Core function. We proposed core function coefficients selection method, which allows configuration of the Core function dynamic range and simplifies the conversion complexity. New algorithm allows to achieve up to 13% of hardware area and up to 51% of power consumption reduction and become up to 17% faster than existing best optimized implementations of RNS reverse convertors for the large arbitrary moduli set.

articleTitle: Optimization Model of Digital Higher Education - SMART University 4.0
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The new industrial revolution, based on digitalization and networking, which we are witnessing, requires modernization of most economic institutions, including the education system, and offers for this modernization not only a new set of priorities, technologies, but also new principles of flexibility, individualization, maximization of efficiency. In other words, it creates an opportunity and a need, necessary and sufficient conditions for building a new model of education. The main tasks in creating a new e-university are the introduction of new processes of design, production, systematization, storage and delivery of educational content, as well as modernization of management and administration of the educational process.This article discusses a set of proposals for building a new optimized and adaptive model for higher education, based on the concept of digital SMART - University or University 4.0.

articleTitle: The Switcher Neuron Network Application in Information Coding and Data Transfer Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The object of research is the neuron network with the special switcher structure. The subject of research is the neuron network application in information coding and data transfer systems. The tools used for research are artificial intelligence methods and neuron networks. The artificial neuron network must be trained previously. The goal is to reduce time of the neuron network training and expenses on the neuron network design. The new way of information coding on base of the artificial neural networks was developed. Application fields are the data transfer systems used the radio channels, mobile communications, telecommunications.

articleTitle: Development of a Block Diagram for Managing the Process of Adaptive Printing on FDM Printers
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: High -tech production enterprises using additive production technologies are faced with the issue of increasing the economic efficiency of the production process. Given the specifics of the printing technology of polymer products, an increase in the efficiency of production of complex forms and requiring large time costs for production is of particular importance. The introduction of automated adaptive control over the process of production of products will significantly reduce production time, material intensity of production, eliminate the need to control a person behind the production process, reduce the cost of production, and increase the accuracy and repeatability of the production of products. The development of a universal broad-profile print management system requires the availability of software, hardware and information and statistical tools that serve to form an adaptive management tool. The article presents a model of the adaptive seal management scheme on FDM printers using a group of related databases.

articleTitle: Digital Quality Management Audit with Extra Criteria for Data Safety and Personal Data Requirement
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article describes changes in the approach for quality audit process in digital environment. Digitalization, or, as it is also called, digital transformation is a deep introduction of modern information technologies into business processes, which allows to bring the organization to a new level of development. This is not only about installing additional equipment and software, but about a radical restructuring of all processes taking place in the facility. Digitalization changes approaches to management, develops additional ways of communication (both within the organization and with the outside world), quality audit can contribute to the improvement of a digital company. In this article, explain the process of protect data with specific IT algorithms and tools. Quality management audit is an essential part of the quality management system and international quality standards such as ISO 9001, ISO 13485, in addition, it is a tool for continuous improvement of the QMS based on the PDCA cycle. Also in this article, an assessment was made of the requirements and weaknesses of data security and the preservation of personal data.

Author Keywords: digital audit of the quality management system

articleTitle: Intelligent Software Agent for Solving Choice Problems under Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The intelligent software agent is designed to solve multinomial choice problems with visual uncertainty in automated information systems, in which it is required to select the right solutions that match the search conditions. An algorithm for making decisions of multinomial choice based on intelligent methods of data analysis has been developed. An exact solution of a series of perceptual-cognitive tasks was obtained in automatic mode. The CAPTCHA-E program is used in scientific research and education for modeling, analyzing the results of solving a series of test tasks, as well as in developing and analyzing new methods based on the visual form of information presentation, which focuses on the integration of human sensory and cognitive abilities in cyber-physical systems.

articleTitle: The System for Diagnosing a Passenger Car, as an Element of Information Security and Management of an Operational Resource
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Improving the level of information security of socially important objects. Development of new models and methods for improving the passenger car diagnostic system.

articleTitle: BI Solutions as a Tool for the Management of Quality of Company’s Project Activities
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper presents analysis of the usefulness of using business intelligence tools to maintain a company's capacity to compete in the marketplace. The potential use of an analysis tool is also discussed using the example of a power engineering firm that executes resource-intensive projects. This study took into account the key issues with implementing such programs, solutions for them, and an illustration of the Business Intelligence tool's design. Based on the findings of the study, conclusions were reached regarding the possibly beneficial impact of employing the tool within the context of project management as well as the potential for scaling the deployment of such solutions.

articleTitle: Practical Approach to Lean Manufacturing Development and Training
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article identifies the needs of stakeholders and proposes the concept of Lean Manufacturing (LM) Competence Center in high-tech industries. The approach of practical training is based on conjunction with industrial partners, the university and the professional community of lean manufacturing. The levels of competences needed are identified and there is a group of training activities are proposed. The approach of LM Competence Center is related with international practice of Quality Management and LM education and development and it can be realized in the other education centers.

articleTitle: Application of a Sensor Based on a Deceleration System for Measuring Movements
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This paper presents the results of a research on the possibility of using a sensor based on deceleration systems to measure the distance to a flat metal surface with a sensing element in the form of a deceleration system consisting of two connected flat spiral inductance coils with opposite winding direction. In the course of the work the properties of retarding systems were investigated, a method for obtaining measurement information from retarding systems was proposed, an algorithm for autonomous operation of the sensor was developed, structural and circuit diagrams of the sensor were designed, a model of the sensor was made and its evaluation tests were conducted, the software for calibration of sensor operation, processing and output of measurement information, as well as auxiliary software for automation of the laboratory instrument operation was developed. According to the results of the work, conclusions were made about the possibility of applied application of sensors for measuring linear movements on the basis of deceleration systems when designing devices and systems for control, monitoring and measuring parameters of technological processes.

articleTitle: Intelligent Information System for Optimizing the Production Planning Process
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article presents an intelligent information system that allows, on the basis of various problem-oriented optimization methods, to automate the planning process and form optimal production schedules for flexible multi-assortment productions. The core of the proposed system are intelligent interfaces that allow ergonomically configuring the system by filling in expert tables of reconfiguration of units and production lines from one type of product to another, formalizing the representation of knowledge about the characteristics of production involved in the formation of the formulation of the optimization problem and the objective function. Information support is described, including updated and augmented databases developed on the basis of intelligence maps that allow graphically structuring information about the parameters of products, orders and equipment involved in planning. Visualization of planning results is presented in the form of a calendar plan - a Gantt chart, as well as in the form of an explanatory tree for solving the optimization problem, which allows you to track the improvement of the value of the objective function at all stages of optimization. The proposed architecture and functionality ensure the variability of the application of the system and its effective use for various flexible multi-assortment productions. The implementation of the system makes it possible to significantly increase the efficiency of the planning process, reduce the cost of production and simplify the process of making production control decisions.

articleTitle: E-learning Implementation in Project-modular Foreign Language Training for Electronic and Computer Engineering Students
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article reveals the key aspects of project-modular e-learning in the South Ural State University, the Higher School of Electronic Engineering and Computer Science. The principle of project-modular materials' organization involves the training in the form of professionally-oriented modules for ESP (English for Specific Purposes) on virtual online platform. The aim of our research is to implement project-modular e-learning training model. The following research tasks are solved: project-modular e-learning model is tested, the level of academic performance is evaluated, score-rating assessment system is introduced and feedback questionnaire is conducted. Theoretical (analysis of modern scientific and methodological literature) and empirical (questionnaire, methods of mathematical processing of the obtained data) methods are applied in the study. This research shows that the implementation of project-modular e-learning training model for ESP had a positive impact on students' academic performance and the level of students` satisfaction with the education process.

Author Keywords: electronic and computer engineering students’ ESP training

articleTitle: Intellectual Technologies Management of Organizational Queuing Systems Structure with a Non-stationary Flow of Requests
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The class of queuing systems for the flow of requests, arriving randomly, is considered. The features of systems of this class are determined as a non-stationary flow of requests and hierarchical "units", called service lines. Attention is drawn to the growing role of the human factor in organizational queuing systems. This circumstance leads to the application of the principles of subject-oriented management and simulation methodology. Taking into account the non-stationarity of the flow of requests in the considered class of systems, in order to exclude failures, the principle of transition of the system to a new level of structural control is applied. This principle is analogous to the bifurcation process and catastrophe theory. A model example of the application of structural management of an organizational queuing system is given.

articleTitle: Advanced Radiophysical Approaches in Biomedicine: Digital Technology and Devices Based on New Physical Principles
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The results by the authors in the application of the advanced radiophysical approaches in the following biomedicine directions, oriented on medical practice: 1) passive noninvasive methods and devices for early diagnosis and monitoring of the patient’s condition; 2) systems for radio frequency identification and diagnostic&treatment process control in the presence of pandemic, are under consideration.

articleTitle: The Intelligent Control System Function Mechanism for International Container Freight Transportation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article reveals the mechanism of building an intelligent control system for international multimodal transportation. The proposed system integrates modern information and telematics technologies and it is intended for automated search and adoption of the most effective scenarios for managing freight container transportation. The authors characterize the intelligent freight transportation control system from the perspective of evaluating the technology of the digital enterprise 4.0. The digital transportation enterprise uses SMAC technologies to optimize the cost of corporate functions and increase its productivity. The intelligent control system makes it possible to improve the "traceability" of international multimodal transportation.

articleTitle: Certification Opportunities for Integrated Management Systems at Electrical Engineering Companies Using Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This paper discusses the concept of certification and objects for which this process is applicable, including the certification of integrated management system at electrical engineering companies. We have studied the existing procedure for carrying out certification of the object under consideration with a visit to the company for audit; the possibility and the need to conduct online audits of integrated management systems in modern world. We have analyzed the current legal aspects of the certification process in Russia, including prerequisites for implementing certification stages online. We have considered the recent experience of Russian certification bodies in certification activities performed by way of online assessment due to the closure of borders in the difficult epidemiological situation. We have analyzed the risks associated with certification of integrated management systems at electrical engineering companies by way of online audits. We have developed the procedure and suggested actions to be taken to ensure reliable online certification of integrated management systems.

articleTitle: Optoelectronic Quality Control of Apples Using Methods of Multidimensional Statistical Analysis in the Frames of Lean Manufacturing Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article presents the results of a study on the use of multidimensional statistical analysis methods for classifying apples by quality when sorting them based on hyper spectral visualization of radiation reflected from the surface of an object in the visible and near infrared ranges. The initial data from the SPECIM FX10 hyper spectrometer were preprocessed in order to normalize the spectrograms, as well as to determine the vegetation indices that play the role of predictors in discriminant analysis. The method of principal components allows to reduce the number of input data without significant loss of accuracy of apple defect recognition. Experimental results show that the multiple discriminant method of hyper spectral image analysis has a great potential for identifying apple defects, such as rotting, scab, wormholes, as well as for sorting apples by quality. At the same time, the accuracy of recognition of healthy apple tissues is no longer 95 %.The method has a significant potential for lean production by laborsaving and mistake proofing.

articleTitle: Digital University – University 4.0
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article discusses how digital transformation and the creation of a Digital University, also known as a University 4.0, can update the educational system. The major obstacles to creating a new educational system are examined, as well as solutions.The key tasks in building a new digital university are the introduction of new procedures for the design, production, systematization, storage, and transmission of educational information, as well as the modernization of the management and administration of the educational process. The integration of e-learning into the university system’s overall corporate information system and business architecture is based on integrated organizational and functional structures, IT architectures with their own rules, responsibilities, people, processes, systems of interaction and relationships, i.e. a new business structure built into the university system’s overall corporate information system and business architecture.The article explains how the university’s business procedures, services, and IT infrastructure enable the seamless running of University 4.0.

articleTitle: The Modeling Digital Transformation of the Regional Container Transportation Organization
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article discusses the issue of creating an intelligent international checkpoint. The authors investigate the digital platform for tracking and managing international cargo transportation "TradeLens", created on the basis of blockchain technology. A mathematical model of the process of international multimodal transportation in the conditions of information threats is proposed. The model allows us to obtain quantitative estimates of the probabilities of information security violations based on the interaction of individual sensors. The authors use the architecture of smart contracts to develop automated information and control systems of an intelligent checkpoint. The effectiveness of the developed method is investigated on the example of the southern region.

articleTitle: Methods of Timely Prevention from Advanced Persistent Threats on the Enterprise Automated Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Counteracting the most dangerous attacks – advanced persistent threats – is an actual problem of modern enterprises. Usually these threats aimed not only at information resources but also at software and hardware resources of automated systems of industrial plants. As a rule, attackers use a number of methods including social engineering methods. The article is devoted to development of the methods for timely prevention from advanced persistent threats based on analysis of attackers’ tactics. Special attention in the article is paid to methods for detection provocations of the modernization of protection systems, as well as methods for monitoring the state of resources of the main automated system. Technique of identification of suspicious changes in the resources is also considered in the article. The result of applying this set of methods will help to increase the protection level of automated systems’ resources.

articleTitle: Optical Control Method for Additive CNC Machines
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: At present, technologies of layer-by-layer building up of material - additive technologies - have become widespread in various industries. Despite the fact that these technologies have been actively developing over the past decades, some areas of additive technologies have a number of problems that reduce the quality of the final product or increase the debugging time of the technological process and manufacturing.This article discusses the problem of adhesion of the first layer of the manufactured part to the base platform in the production of parts by additive methods. As a solution to the problem, this article discusses a method for upgrading the control system of an additive CNC machine tool by introducing a feedback channel based on optical sensors. The adhesion control of the first layer of the manufactured product, as well as timely notification of the loss of adhesion between the table and the product, will significantly reduce the time for debugging the program controllers and reduce the reject rate.

articleTitle: Organization of a Safe Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Landing Using Computer Vision in Conditions of Potential Input Visual Information Distortion
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper presents a computer vision system for safe landing of an unmanned aerial vehicle in the situation of possible input visual information distortions. An algorithm for image preprocessing was developed, consisting of increasing contrast by equalizing the intensity histogram, followed by applying a Gaussian filter to remove extra noise. The landing platform has two states: open and closed. For their recognition, the YOLOv3-tiny neural network was modified. The accuracy of recognition for the test set was 0.97. The algorithm was integrated into the Jetson Nano. The achieved frame processing time was 0.05 seconds, which allows real-time processing of the video stream.

articleTitle: The Significance and Importance of Dynamic Endurance Testing in Quality Management Systems for Railway Structures
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The quality properties are based on the imperfection of objects and processes at all stages of the life cycle of parts without exception: defects and degradation processes of raw materials and components, operation errors, limited accuracy and reliability of technological, endurance test, control and measuring equipment. When upgrading or developing new nodes, it is necessary to conduct a preliminary assessment of the effectiveness of implementations. In particular, to predict the reliability and stability of the system to various impacts.In this paper, we will consider both the basis for the formation of functional models and the description of the possibilities of using modern computer systems that solve the problem of analyzing dynamic processes that have a significant impact on railway complexes, such as wagons, trolleys, couplings, etc.One of the promising areas of development is to determine the properties of real objects by studying their computer models.

articleTitle: Steering Utilization in Vehicle Stabiliization Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Modern vehicle stabilization systems (ESP) use brake and engine control to prevent or stop a skid. However, over the past few years, in the field of road transport, there has been a widespread introduction of automatic piloting systems. As a result of this fact, it becomes possible to improve such systems so, that steering can be also used in the process of the skid elimination. This can further increase ESP efficiency and traffic safety. In the course of this work, a prototype of an automatic stabilization system was developed, which operates by steering of the front wheels. The system was implemented as an electronic device and tested on a special scale model capable of simulating the behavior of a car on a slippery surface.

articleTitle: Quality Data Analysis in the Service Management System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The company must always keep an eye on its services and service management system, monitor and measure performance, analyze and evaluate the data obtained in order to implement improvements based on evidence. The article explores sources of quality data in Service Management System, communications and decision-making process according to standard ISO/IEC 20000-1:2018.

articleTitle: Electronic Tools to Form Safety Value of Future Engineers in Digital Evironment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Health and safety issues in engineering are of utmost importance as in recent years they are aggravated by the dangers of a digital environment. The reason is the rapid development of information technologies that increases occupational risks. The authors state that the promotion of the value of safety in future engineers will help to decrease occupational risks. It can be done in the process of learning with the usage of electronic tools to be enhanced considering the changes taking place in a digital environment. The aim of the study is to create a model of electronic tools’ usage to form safety value in future engineers capable of working in a digital environment. To achieve this, the authors defined the content of the concept "safety value" in terms of transformation in a digital environment; singled out electronic tools used to develop a model to form safety value of future engineers and evaluated the efficiency of the model.

articleTitle: Digital Transformation of Mining and Technological Mapping of Rock Masses Operational Data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In the context of constant changes in the global demand and world prices for mineral raw materials, the most important task is to ensure the reliability of long-term planning of its extraction and processing. In the process of ensuring planning, the technology of digital transformation of the initial data for filling the block model of deposits, which should not depend on the subjective component, comes to the fore. A hardware-software complex for monitoring changes in the energy indicators of excavation of the inter-well space is proposed, which are proposed to be used as a criterion for mining and technological mapping of rock masses. The obtained accuracy of binding the mapping results under conditions of changes in the parameters of the grid of wells during the transition from one category of rock explosibility to another has been established. In the hardware-software complex, the GPS module has an auxiliary value - only for linking the monitoring results to the terrain. The Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) is of central importance. This configuration allows you to objectively evaluate the effectiveness of geomechanical support (preparation of the face) of the excavator based on the results of real-time monitoring. The required accuracy of binding the measurement results to the studied interwell space is ensured by the correspondence of the studied interwell space of parameters to the parameters of the downhole block. The duration of data accumulation from the satellite during the working out of the downhole block (from one location) provides the necessary accuracy of position registration commensurate with the dimensions of the excavator bucket and the parameters of the downhole block.

Author Keywords: identified working out of the downhole block
fixing the trajectories of the excavator bucket
measurement position of the excavator bucket and energy parameters of scooping

articleTitle: Information and Analytical Tools Development for Cyber-Physical Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Cyber-physical systems are a complex concept. To date, there is no single definition, since these systems are at the intersection of several areas of science at once. However, the main characteristic of such systems is the integration between computational processes and physical processes. A system continuously receives data from the environment and uses it to optimize management processes.The construction of information and analytical tools allows us to solve this problem. But it must be taken into account that data is received using various types of sensors and information can be obtained in various forms - both in the form of raw text logs and in the form of database strings of transactional systems. The issue of integrating such data and analytics is the key issue in this article.

articleTitle: Efficient Two-level RNS Reverse Conversion Algorithm for Big Number of Modules
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Residue Number System (RNS) has a big potential for the hardware accelerators due to its high area and performance efficiency for arithmetic computations based on multiplications and additions only. The choice of moduli set has a significant impact on the RNS efficiency. In general case, using arbitrary modulo, an increase in the number of moduli leads to the corresponding decrease of the average modulo size achieving less hardware area and power consumption, but this usually makes conversion algorithms less efficient. This article presents a two-level method for reverse conversion of a number in RNS to a Binary Number System (BNS) based on a combination of Core-function based methods and Mixed Radix Conversion (MRC) based methods for three-moduli set 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sup>, 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sup> + 1, 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sup> – 1. We demonstrated how to choose modulo properly in order to achieve up to 64% of hardware area reduction, up to 97% of power consumption reduction and become up to 53% faster than traditional CRT-based methods.

articleTitle: Features of the Preparatory Phase of the ERP System Implementation Project
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper considers the preparatory stage for the implementation of the ERP system. Attention is drawn to the implicit stages of the preparatory stage. Emphasis is placed on the correct sequence of actions for conducting automation. The dependence of the successful completion of the implementation project on the successive completion of the steps of the preparatory phase of the project is substantiated.

articleTitle: HR EDI Projects Risk Assessment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This publication deals with the current status of security and protection of personal data when implementing HR record-keeping in electronic document management systems. A brief analysis of the applicable law is provided, as well as the specifics of establishing a methodology for teamwork, auditing and bringing information systems into compliance with legal requirements. The risks of electronic signatures implementation in the company are considered separately.These data make it possible to make conclusions on the necessity to identify the protection objects, leakage channels, actual cases of attacks and the best methods of counteraction. Separately, the practice of establishing a team of professional auditors able to assess and reassess risks (residual risks) is considered.The presented results may be used in design, development and security provision for HR record-keeping projects in electronic document management systems of different companies.

articleTitle: Automation of Routine Information Processes in Supply Chain: Search Methodology and Tool, Evaluation of Potential Based on Lean Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper aims to introduce the data-driven methods of the routine information processes analysis in supply chain. In terms of the supply chain digital transformation, the processes discovering and evaluating their potential of automation are considered essential. The paper shows quantitative methods of detection and evaluation and approach to measure their efficiency. We focus on lean manufacturing methods including customer value / business value stream mapping to find and evaluate the information processes that need to be automized. The results demonstrate that the methods described foster reducing waste of resources and improving efficiency in supply chain information processes.

articleTitle: Conceptual Modeling of Organisation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: An approach to modeling complex organizational and technical systems at the stage of their preliminary (conceptual) design, when there is no formalized description of such systems, is proposed. Current concepts and best practices of successful activity and automation of organizations are effective at the stage of technical design, but do not determine the methods and notations of conceptual model development. The application of rational IDEF-methods is justified, which allow to identify the required structure and parameters of the organization's process system at a given planning horizon for the subsequent generation of requirements for the system of automated technologies of such an organization.

articleTitle: The Control Mode Identification Using Structural-Parametric Time Series Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The study of the properties and features of objects using modern methods of information processing is based on the construction of a mathematical model of the object under study based on the observed data. Quite often, in various application areas, there is not a prior information about the structure and parameters of objects and control systems. To understand the features of the operation of control systems to create an adequate model, it becomes necessary to identify the control action from experimental data. During the operation of complex systems, the control action can vary significantly depending on external and internal (for example, the appearance of defects) factors. Using a large amount of data, artificial intelligence methods, as well as the capabilities of modern computing tools, it becomes possible to identify hidden patterns that have a different temporal hierarchy. In this paper, it is proposed to use the method of structural-parametric analysis of time series to identify the modes of the control action. Examples of the use of this method for biological and technical systems are given. The effectiveness of using the approach for the analysis of complex structured data is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Implementation of ESG Sustainable Development Concept Criteria Using the Robust Design Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article describes an attempt to solve the problem of sustainable development. The strategy for achieving sustainable development goals is based on the implementation of criteria of the ESG concept. In order to implement an architecture of the integrated environmental processes and solve the tasks of social partnership and management in the conditions of uncertainty, it is reasonable to use the robust parametric designing methods. The integrated architecture process, including documentation and certification processes, is defined in accordance with the ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010 standard. In implementing the ESG criteria, it is necessary to account for the requirements of information security and sustainable development standards: ISO/IEC 27001, ISO 37101, ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148, and Recommended Practice for Software Requirements specifications. The degree of compliance of the tasks set with the forest management standards FSC is analyzed.

articleTitle: Models and Methods of Data Mining in Project Management
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article discusses Data Mining in the field of Project Management in terms of identifying hidden patterns or relationships between objects in large data sets. Theoretical foundations and tasks that are solved during the application of data mining are considered. The properties and features of existing methods of data mining are analyzed and described - from the construction of decision trees to neural networks. Tasks and problems in the field of project management are formulated, which can be solved using the methods of data mining.

articleTitle: Theoretical Analysis of the Convolutional Neural Networks Acceleration by Organizing Calculations According to the Winograd Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Convolutional neural networks are promising tool for pattern recognition. Implementations of convolutional neural networks require a significant number of computations during training and processing. In this paper we propose to use Winograd method to reduce computational complexity in convolutional layers of convolutional neural networks. Theoretical analysis of the convolutional layer’s computational complexity of convolutional neural networks showed that the use of the Winograd method can reduce the computational complexity compared with direct method by 26,75%, 17,01%, with filter sizes of 3×3, 5×5, respectively. A promising area of further research is the hardware implementation of convolutional layers with Winograd calculations on modern computing devices, such as FPGA and ASIC.

articleTitle: The Use of Wavelet Analysis for the Diagnosis of Obstructive Sleep Apnea Syndrome
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This work aims to identify biomarkers in the electrical activity of the brain during sleep associated with obstructive sleep apnea syndrome. For this purpose, work was carried out on the registration of polysomnographic records in apparently healthy subjects and patients with obstructive sleep apnea syndrome. Further, studies of synchronization between different EEG channels were carried out based on the use of continuous wavelet transform. At the same time, a number of features were revealed in synchronization between different EEG channels in patients with obstructive sleep apnea syndrome compared with conditionally healthy subjects.

articleTitle: Measurement Module Polling Algorithm and Indirect Measurement Evaluation in a Personalized Distributed Information and Measurement System with Standalone Measurement Modules
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The report seeks to develop an algorithm for polling measurement modules and estimating the error of indirect measurements in a personalized distributed information and measurement system with autonomous measurement modules and transmission of the results to the central computer. Such values as the pace and rhythm of walking are measured indirectly in a personalized distributed information and measurement system, and an error estimate is carried out for these parameters.

articleTitle: Features of Managing the Digital Transformation of Medical Institutions
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article discusses the features of managing the digital transformation of medical institutions. The main tools and approaches to digital transformation, the possibility of their application at various stages are determined. The methods of digital transformation of medical institutions are analyzed and their limitations are identified. The results of the analysis of approaches, methods and digital tools make it possible to take into account the features of management and choose the most appropriate tools, approaches and methods for digital transformation in a medical institution.

Author Keywords: approaches and methods of digital transformation

articleTitle: Modeling Data Flows of a System for Analyzing Messages in Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: There is a problem associated with an overabundance of information: users write hundreds of posts every day, leave thousands of comments, which makes it difficult to search, structure and analyze useful data. Especially in the case of creating a distributed network, it is also important to calculate the load on the network so that it works smoothly and as quickly as possible.This paper describes the creation of a system for modeling data flows of a message analysis system in social networks with the ability to change the composition and structure of a distributed network to estimate the amount of transmitted traffic with a different number of processing points for incoming data.

articleTitle: Methodology for Ensuring EDI Security
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This publication covers the actual issues of developing up-to-date methodological basis for providing security of electronic document management systems.The brief analysis of challenges in ensuring security is given. In particular, the results of the transition from "local" automation to projects covering the entire enterprise, outdated traditions of paper document processing, fear and rejection of current information security systems are presented.Based on the data presented it is possible to conclude that the applicable Russian laws (Federal Law "On Personal Data", Federal Law "On an Electronic Signature", etc.) are sufficient to ensure the security of electronic document interchange services. We would like to separately note the necessity to take into account the Compliance requirements, e.g., ISO 9001, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 37301 standards.The represented outcomes can be used in ensuring security of modern electronic document management systems at all stages of the life cycle.

articleTitle: Development of an Automated System of Light and Sound Warning about the Approach of the Rolling Stock to the Place of Work on the Railway Tracks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the problem of ensuring the safety of work on railways based on a software and hardware complex for managing the actions of personnel and drivers of rolling stock. An analysis is being carried out showing the feasibility of using hardware for light and sound warning of the approach of the rolling stock to the place of work on the railway tracks. An automated system has been developed, including: a network of sensors for the proximity of the rolling stock to the work area; means of signaling to warn the work crew; data radio transmission system to the locomotive driver; a system of light and sound warning of the driver about the danger of a collision. Recommendations are proposed for the development of a reliable automated system to improve the safety of work on railways.

articleTitle: Improvement of Computer Recognition of Foam Layer Criteria
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Foam bed flotation processes are common in the poly metallic, potash and food industries. A worker who visually assesses the condition of the foam bed controls the process. This reduces process control and product quality because of the human factor. Using computer vision is based on bubble boundary recognition to control due to poor lighting, low foam contrast, and splash back. Recognition is possible by analyzing the glare from the foam surface. We attempt to improve recognition by accounting for the dark antiglare that takes place due to the bubble deformation. It improved recognition and reduced the noise of the method to a few percents.

articleTitle: Digital Transformation of Management Systems Security
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This publication considers general areas of information security provision at contemporary management systems transformation. Recent examples of national and global digital transformation projects, which provide users' verification, as well as tools to ensure the confidentiality of information exchange, are given.Features of digital transformation of crosscutting processes of modern management systems, including: information storing and retrieval, approval process, collection of analytical data and report generation are reviewed. On the basis of the data presented it is possible to conclude that there is a need to develop and maintain several reliable fault-tolerant channels for accessing documents and using modern certified means of information protection.These results can be implemented when performing the digital transformation of modern management systems and creating an integrated, continuous and highly protective information security system

articleTitle: Methods of Information Technology Quality Control at the Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the methods of information technology quality control recommended for use within the enterprise to increase the efficiency of digital transformation.

articleTitle: Object Grasping as an Element of Autonomous Robotic Assembly Operation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article covers the issues on increasing the autonomy of manipulation robots (MR), when performing assembly operations. One of the steps towards this objective is automatic planning and performance of a typical MR operation such as grasping of an object that is a component of the assembled structure. An isolated grasping of the object may not be suitable for subsequent joining of that object to the assembled structure. To prevent such situation, the article addresses grasping as the element of assembly operation, and not as an isolated operation. It is considered acceptable if the grasping meets the specified requirements both as an isolated operation and as part of assembly operation. To solve this problem the mathematical relations are provided. The relations are confirmed by calculations obtained using a model based on Kawasaki industrial robots.

articleTitle: Experience in Finding and Registering Vulnerabilities in Web Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article discusses current ways to search for vulnerabilities in web applications. The most popular classifications of vulnerabilities are presented. During the study, the authors discovered a vulnerability in a web application and registered it in the international database of vulnerabilities CVE and Vulnerability Data Bank (VDU).

articleTitle: Acceleration of Signal Prediction in Wireless Sensor Networks Based on Kalman Filter and Goldschmidt Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The expansion of possibilities in the use of wireless sensor networks requires the continuous improvement of their technical characteristics. From this point of view, the development of promising methods and algorithms for the transmission and processing of digital data obtained from sensor sensors in wireless sensor networks in real time is one of the topical areas of research in digital signal processing. Known methods and algorithms for data processing are based on computational structures, including the execution of the arithmetic operation of division. Performing a division operation increases the computational complexity of the system, which leads to a significant decrease in the performance of the wireless sensor network. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a modified probabilistic Kalman filtering algorithm with a Goldschmidt divisor. Software simulation showed that the time-varying filter has a higher performance than the known Kalman filtering algorithm and the same measurement error caused by the presence of measurement noise. The resulting algorithm can be effectively applied in various monitoring systems.

articleTitle: Influence of Localization of Bandgap Fluctuations in a Semiconductor Superlattice on the Characteristics of Current Oscillations
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper considers how, with a change in the localization of the band gap fluctuations, the amplitude and frequency of the current oscillations change, as well as the threshold voltage value at which the generation of current oscillations begins. Semiconductor superlattices in the current fluctuation generation mode demonstrate frequencies up to several tens of gigahertz, which makes them promising transmitters in infocommunication data transmission systems. It is shown in this work that the localization of the band gap fluctuation fluctuation strongly affects the characteristics of the current, while the influence of fluctuation localization in the case in the presence of an inclined magnetic field and without it differ significantly.

articleTitle: Improving the Reliability of the Railway Automation System to Prevent Collisions with Rolling Stock
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the problem of ensuring the safety of processes at a railway station related to the movement of rolling stock. An analysis of the sources of danger to the health and life of personnel during the operation of the railway track was carried out. A general conceptual mathematical model is constructed that describes this problem. The architecture of the software and hardware complex is proposed, which ensures the safety of the functioning of the railway station. The parameters of the dynamics of the rolling stock are analyzed, which are necessary for carrying out subsequent monitoring and taking control actions. As a particular example, a portable device has been developed that provides current monitoring of the speed of the rolling stock at control points for the further functioning of the automated control system. Recommendations are proposed to improve the reliability of the railway automation system to ensure the safety of processes at the railway station.

articleTitle: Increase of the Navigation Landmark Detection Accuracy Based on the Computer Vision Methods in a Lack of Visibility
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This paper presents the computer vision system for navigation of an unmanned vehicle based on the use of navigation landmarks in a lack of Visibility. The CNN-based image preprocessing algorithm has been developed to improve the accuracy of navigation landmarks recognition in conditions inherent to the far north (snow, fog). The modified CNN YOLOv4 was used for the recognition. The recognition accuracy of the pre-processed images resulted in 84%.

articleTitle: The Influence of Training on the Construction of Evoked Potentials during Visual Stimulation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The present study compared evoked potentials in two groups of people with visual stimulation using a bistable image (Necker cube). The first group consisted of people who had seen this bistable image many times in various previous tests. The second group consisted of people passing the test with a bistable image for the first time. During the experiment, the subject was shown a large number of cubes with different intensities of the inner faces. For each cube, the subject had to determine its orientation (left or right) and press the corresponding button on the remote control. For the processing of evoked potentials, a new method of automatic labeling by amplitudes and latency times of the evoked potential components was used. The features of the formation of evoked potentials for these two experimental groups were shown.

articleTitle: Intelligent Technologies for Projective Thinking and Research Management in the Knowledge Representation System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: It is proposed to address existing methodological issues in the educational process with the development of intellectual technologies and knowledge representation systems to improve the efficiency of higher education institutions. For this purpose, the structure of relational database is proposed, it will store the information about defended dissertations in the form of a set of attributes (heuristics), representing the mandatory qualification attributes of theses. An inference algorithm is proposed to process the information. This algorithm represents an artificial intelligence, its work is aimed at generating queries based on the applicant preferences. The result of the algorithm's work will be a set of choices, presented in ranked order. Given technologies will allow applicants to quickly become familiar with known scientific results and serve as a starting point for new research. The demand for co-researcher practice in solving the problem of updating the projective thinking methodology and managing the scientific research process has been justified. This article pays attention to the existing parallels between the concepts of technical and human sciences in the framework of their convergence. The concepts of being (economic good and economic utility) and the concepts of consciousness (humanitarian economic good and humanitarian economic utility) are used to form projective thinking. They form direct and inverse correspondences of technology and humanitarian practice in the techno-humanitarian mathematical space. It is proposed to place processed information from the language of context-free formal grammar dissertation abstracts in this space. The principle of data manipulation based on formal languages with context-free grammar allows to create new structures of subject areas in terms of applicants' preferences.It is believed that the success of applicants’ work depends directly on the cognitive training of applicants, which needs to be practiced psychologically. This practice is based on deepening the objectivity and adequacy qualities of obtaining information on the basis of heuristic methods. It requires increased attention and development of intelligence. The paper studies the use of heuristic methods by applicants to find new research directions leads to several promising results. These results can be perceived as potential options in future research. This contributes to an increase in the level of retention of higher education professionals.

articleTitle: Deepfakes and Information Security Issues
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In the era of information technology development, new threats to information security have appeared. One of the new trends in this area is the deepfake. This article examines the essence of the term «deepfake», the history of its origin and the features of the impact on information. Algorithms for its creation and distribution are also considered. An assessment is given to the problem of the threat of the spread of deepfakes in the media, including on the Internet and on television. Possible solutions to the identified problem are considered.

articleTitle: The Digital Transformation of Technogenic Risks Management at the Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article discusses the issues of transformation of enterprise risk management processes in the context of digitalization. Based on the identification of technogenic risks and the models used for their assessment, the authors propose the use of intelligent information systems for the accumulation and processing of data that can influence the implementation of a risk event. Taking into account the proposals, risk assessment indicators have been developed and an algorithm of industrial safety management has been compiled, including a set of dynamic endo- and exogenous variables. A structural risk management model for their minimization using cloudware has been considered.

articleTitle: Predictive Analytics Approach for Steel Billets Quality Control System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper deals with the problem of improving the quality of metal products. Nowadays destructive methods of quality control of the steel billets prevail at metallurgical enterprises. This approach to assessing the quality of the steel billets is wasteful, which increases its cost. One of the ways to reduce the cost of production of metal products is to decrease the use of the destructive control methods through automatic certification of metals. The paper proposes to use an algorithm for predicting the mechanical properties of the final product based on the analysis of data obtained during the production of the steel products.The prediction algorithm is chosen based on the classical deep machine learning models. The target model is the one that shows the highest accuracy. This paper presents the results of applying modern machine learning algorithms for predicting the mechanical properties of steel billets and automatic certification of metal according to predicted values. The results of the study are planned to be implemented at the Metallurgical Complex Mill-5000 of OJSC Vyksa Metallurgical Plant.

articleTitle: Automated System for Cognitive Load Analyzing in the Blended Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The task of determining the cognitive load in a blended learning environment (traditional plus electronic) is relevant for a number of reasons. The main ones are the conditions created for the forced transition of the learning process to a combined mode, redundancy of information resources, differences in the students training and uncertainty types of that were not previously taken into account in the educational process. Three blocks of questions are solved in the automated system: 1 - diagnostics of the cognitive-style potential, 2 - evaluation of the cognitive load of information content, 3 - implementation of recommendations for building an individual training program. Decisions on the use of intelligent agents, Text Mining methods and data analysis methods are based.

articleTitle: Using Online Courses in the Educational Process
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The experience of St. Petersburg Electrotechnical University is considered.
