The characteristics of models for embedding elements of e-learning and distance learning technologies into the educational process are given. The technology of information and technical support of the educational process using online courses is given. The principles and stages of examination of online courses developed at the university are presented. An analysis of a sociological survey of students on their perception of online courses is given. An example of a technology for developing an online master’s program is given. The data of a comparative analysis of full-time education and training based on online courses are presented.

articleTitle: Development and Implementation of Service Management System in IT-Company for Compliance with International Standard ISO/IEC 20000-1:2018
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In the new context of the digital economy enterprises are increasingly shifting to the area of the services. We buy software as a service, platforms as a service, infrastructure as a service, network as a service, data storage as a service. Everything that we buy now include a service and very few IT-products are without accompanying services. In this situation, service management in IT-company will be more and more in demand over the next years. The Service Management System is becoming an important aspect of business. The article explores determining of the Service Management System processes in an IT-company: structure, composition and interactions according to standard ISO/IEC 20000-1:2018, the structure and composition of the Service Management System documentation.

articleTitle: Aggregation of Engineering and Language Skills Development in the Global Information Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article describes the alternative approach to ESP classes. Taking into account the outlines of the student-centered activity-based approach, we propose to use the Internet as a source of relevant educational materials. This approach entails the following procedure: domain ontology compilation – concept selection – search query – text – text practice – transformed domain – new search query. The study objectives are as follows:1.To identify the types of Internet resources to use in ESP classes.2.To develop the search query typology.3.To conduct an experiment confirming that this approach to ESP classes will enhance professional communicative competence formation, expand domain understanding, and develop general cultural and professional competences of future engineers.The conducted ascertaining experiment allowed us to confirm that the approach we propose broadens the ideas about the domain area. We also managed to identify the features of Internet resources, to analyze the structure and types of search queries as a source of information about the language and information needs of students.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Despeckle Filtering Methods for Ultrasound Images
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Medical image recognition is becoming more in demand every day. For more accurate and faster diagnosis, it is necessary not only to enhance image recognition systems but also to improve the quality of images. Images taken with ultrasound suffer from speckle noise. Due to the fact that the tissue has a texture, irregularities reflect ultrasonic radiation and create a speckle pattern. Speckles give an understanding of the surface topography, but image distortion takes place. Denoising is a commonly effective way to improve image quality. This paper presents a comparative analysis of popular speckle denoising methods. An anisotropic diffusion filter was created and adapted for this task. This work showed that even such a highly specialized filter has its limitations. A filter was found that can compete with it. The results of this work can be used by scientists and developers as a reference on the main types of filters for removing speckle noise.

articleTitle: Ecosystem Nature of Digital Development Strategy and Cardinal Transformation of Business Models
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The essence of ecosystems, principles of formation and concepts of the business ecosystem are substantiated, the ecosystem nature of the digital space development strategy and business transformation tools are revealed. The article substantiates the integrated platform-network business model of a digital company and an interconnected system for the formation of digital business models and the development of network infrastructure as the technological basis of the ecosystem. The results of the analysis of the concepts of the formation of ecosystems of national and international companies, the systematization of platform services and the practical implementation of integrated business models of a digital company on the example of the infocommunication sector are presented. Special attention is paid to the scientific substantiation of the organizational and economic principles of the ecosystem architecture formation in the conditions of the platform economy and the practice of implementing the segment-cluster model.

articleTitle: Information Technologies as a Tool for Bachelor’s Engineering Teamwork Skills Development
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The digitalization of higher education and current realities of society actualize the search for modern information technologies to develop the teamwork skills of future engineers, contributing to the synergy effect in the academic sphere. The aim of the study is to identify the possibilities of integrating information technologies in the educational process to develop teamwork skills of undergraduate engineering students in the course of Technical English. The article applied theoretical analysis of pedagogical literature, used a survey-diagnostic method. Engineering Team Performance Scale was chosen as a diagnostic tool to analyze the effectiveness of team interactions and Fey's Acceptance of Others Scale was used. The study involved 107 undergraduate engineering bachelors. The presented results confirm that the use of information technologies (online service of interactive visual communication Genially, online platform PowToon and web service Trello) significantly influences the efficiency of team interaction process and the result of team activities.

articleTitle: Digital Transformation of Education
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The existing international education system is a product and an element of the first industrial revolution, functions on the basis of the principles of flow type production and specialization, which were established in the 18th century, and solves the problem of maximum coverage of masses of population with typical knowledge sets. At the same time, its priority is not the maximization of the quality of obtained knowledge, its individualization or universalization. Priority tasks of the outdated education system are directly reflected in the construction of its structure and functioning, the striking shortcomings of which are currently manifested, including the growth of international statistical indicators of unemployment against the background of the outstripping growth of the number of unemployed jobs.The article deals with the transformation of education in the transition of society from one technological mode to another and the trends of development.

articleTitle: Sustainability of Lean Manufacturing Tools in Information Processes and Systems Development
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Lean manufacturing tools are relevant because they not only improve the effectiveness of company processes, but also customize the needs of a particular market participant. In the early beginning, Lean principles were applied to production systems, and now the Industry 4.0 demands its implementation to the digital sphere. It can be not only a philosophy, but understandable procedures and instructions, which reflect the requirements of effectiveness in information system development. In the article authors study the effectiveness, reasons of potential failures and ways to successful implementing Lean manufacturing tools to Information Processes and Systems Development.

articleTitle: The Special Aspects of Quality Management of the Organization at the Stage of Digital Transformation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper discusses the application of the process approach in the digital transformation of organizations. The study of the features of quality management at the stage of digital transformation is carried out on the example of universities, for which the risks of reducing the quality of the result when switching to remote work are the highest.The aim of the study is to determine the conditions for ensuring the quality of the digital transformation of the university, taking into account the need for re-engineering of the main processes and a radical change in the competency profile of teachers and support staff. To analyze the features of quality management at the stage of digital transformation, the research task is decomposed into three areas. In each direction, the author’s innovative design technology was used, which was adapted to the tasks of applying the process approach and principles of quality management in practice (1), designing the technology for preparing management teams for the implementation of digital transformation projects (2), and developing a mixed training on the basis of changing the system of labor rationing and ensuring the quality of remote work management (3).These approaches have proven their effectiveness in projects related to the development of digital transformation strategies and programs for their implementation, business process reengineering, and involving personnel in solving strategic problems. The study showed that a necessary condition for ensuring the quality of digital transformation is a deep study of the process model. Participants of educational projects received a double effect in the form of the developed elements of a quality management strategy at the stage of digital transformation and the competencies necessary for this. The results obtained confirmed the importance of a systematic view of digital transformation.

articleTitle: Modeling of the Processes of Glow Discharge Plasma Effect on Work Surfaces Using Intelligent Instrumentation Support
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The conditions of modeling the processes of the impact of glow discharge plasma on the working surfaces of a complex-profile tool to provide a given quality of tools in the effectuation of author's technological processes are reputed. The mechanism of optimal impact of glow discharge plasma on the surface of a complex profile is revealed. The sequence of alternation of technological conversion and their duration for the different impact of the glow discharge plasma is established. This ensures the formation of a given thermodynamic structure to a given depth of the near-surface layer. The structure of an automatic system for oversee and controlling glow discharge plasma generators has been developed. The automatic control system reasonable on uninterrupted oversee implements high reproducibility of the hardening quality of metalworking tools. This system ensures the stabilization of the technological indicator of the processing process and, if required, allows surgical intervention in the course of plasma exposure. At the moment, a boost in the effectiveness of controlling decision support is implemented over the period the formation of glow discharge plasma at technological. The control system, built thanks to efficient modeling of plasma exposure, allows oversee the formation of a thermodynamic structure. The thermodynamic structure created on the working surfaces of the cutting wedge with a small corner of grind and featuring a complex profile is implemented without altering the shape and size.

articleTitle: Developing Self-Directed Learning Skills of Future Engineers in Digital Educational Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Self-directed learning skills are crucial today, as life requires a high level of self-organization, responsibility and the ability to manage everyday activities. The goal of the research is to examine the influence of advanced assessment on developing students’ responsibility as a vital constituent of self-directed learning in digital learning environment, categorize the type of their responsibility, and determine the ways of its boost via assessment in e-learning courses. The survey was conducted among 116 1st and 2nd year students of South Ural State National Research University majoring in engineering. The research has revealed that 2nd year students have promoted comprehensive responsibility compared to 1st year students with situational responsibility. The results of the study prove the efficient impact of advanced assessment in electronic courses aimed at improving student responsibility. The findings of the research will contribute to further development of relevant soft skills requested by self-directed learning of future engineers in digital educational environment.

articleTitle: Methods for Accelerating the Search for the Optimal Distribution of Parallel Processes in Heterogeneous Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper considers the problem of searching the optimal distribution of tasks available for parallel execution among the operating units of a heterogeneous computing system. This problem generates an exponentially growing set of possible solutions the analysis of which takes essential time. In this paper we propose methods to reduce search space based on task decomposition, analysis of the code and architecture of heterogeneous system to accelerate the process of solving of optimization problem.

articleTitle: Digital Transformation of Operational Data of Intelligent Hardware and Software Systems for Automation and Robotization of Mining Operations
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The trend towards the promotion of technological complexes of large unit capacity and the transition to robotic mining are fundamentally changing the requirements for geomechanical support for mining operations.At the same time, the well-known methodologies used, which are limited to obtaining constant physical characteristics of rock samples based on experimental and theoretical mechanics of deformable media, do not describe the variability of rock masses. The existing significant unused technological reserves of the operation of mining complexes in variable rock masses are not revealed by methods for obtaining average values of generalized, calculated indicators of the characteristics of the mechanical properties of rocks. As a result, decisions are made on the basis of non-objective data that depends on the subjective component.A new approach is proposed for the digital transformation of objective hardware monitoring data for the operational management of mining operations. A hardware-software complex has been developed for monitoring changes in the energy performance of the excavator in the inter-well space. The indicators are used as criteria for evaluating the parameters of the excavator face, which determine the capacity of the excavator: the quality of working out the bench bottom; granulometric composition of the broken rock mass and characteristics of the broken-rock disintegration. The design of the proposed hardware-software complex contains an inertial measurement unit (IMU) consisting of a MEMS accelerometer, a gyroscope, a barometer and a magnetometer that measures the orientation of the excavator bucket in space and the energy parameters of scooping.

Author Keywords: automation of technological processes of mining operations
mining and technological mapping of excavator faces
measurement of orientation in space of the excavator bucket and energy parameters of scooping
